job.question: In the SAA investment manager questionnaire for fixed income investment management services, which services is the firm asked to indicate whether it offers, along with any additional fee?
job.expected_facts: Five services: Schedule D investment accounting; asset/liability management (dynamic financial analysis); performance attribution; daily internet access of portfolio information; and SVO filing. For each, the firm marks Yes/No and gives an approximate fee.
job.acceptance: Require all five services; Yes/No and approximate fee wording are useful context, not additional services.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Temple City RFP for 457 plan administration and recordkeeping, not the SAA fixed income investment manager questionnaire. It does not ask firms about the five specified services.
quotes: City of Temple City, California 457 Deferred Compensation Plan Request for Proposals for Plan Administration and Record Keeping Services

The City of Temple City (hereinafter “City” or “Plan Sponsor”) is soliciting proposals from qualified firms (hereinafter “Proposing Firm(s)” or “Firm(s)”) to provide retirement plan administration, record keeping, education, communications, investment-related, and other services for the 457 Deferred Compensation Plan(s)
